description: Source code defining purchase order and purchase order line models for an OpenERP/Odoo module, including methods for calculations, workflow actions, and onchange handlers.

classes.name: purchase_order
classes.description: Model class for purchase orders, including fields, defaults, and workflow methods.

classes.name: purchase_order_line
classes.description: Model class for purchase order lines, including fields and onchange handlers.

methods.name: _calc_amount
methods.description: Calculates total amount for a purchase order based on its lines.

methods.name: _amount_all
methods.description: Computes untaxed amount, tax, and total for purchase orders.

methods.name: _set_minimum_planned_date
methods.description: Sets the minimum planned date for purchase order lines.

methods.name: _minimum_planned_date
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum planned date from order lines.

methods.name: _invoiced_rate
methods.description: Calculates the invoiced rate as a percentage of total amount.

methods.name: _shipped_rate
methods.description: Calculates the shipped/shipped quantity rate.

methods.name: _get_order
methods.description: Gets order IDs associated with purchase order lines.

methods.name: _invoiced
methods.description: Checks if the purchase has been invoiced.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes purchase orders if in draft or canceled state.

methods.name: button_dummy
methods.description: Placeholder method for button actions.

methods.name: onchange_dest_address_id
methods.description: Updates location based on destination address.

methods.name: onchange_warehouse_id
methods.description: Updates location based on warehouse selection.

methods.name: onchange_partner_id
methods.description: Updates partner address, pricelist, and fiscal position when partner changes.

methods.name: wkf_approve_order
methods.description: Workflow to approve a purchase order.

methods.name: wkf_confirm_order
methods.description: Workflow to confirm a purchase order.

methods.name: wkf_warn_buyer
methods.description: Workflow to warn buyer if purchase exceeds limit.

methods.name: inv_line_create
methods.description: Creates invoice line dictionary from purchase order line.

methods.name: action_cancel_draft
methods.description: Resets purchase order to draft state.

methods.name: action_invoice_create
methods.description: Creates invoice from purchase order.

methods.name: has_stockable_product
methods.description: Checks if order contains stockable products.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels purchase order, related pickings, and invoices.

methods.name: action_picking_create
methods.description: Creates stock picking for purchase order.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Duplicates a purchase order with default values.
